title: Playing with Clarence Williams, and drummer Mike Murray
summary: Vincent says he learned mandolin well while playing with Clarence Williams and mentions Cindy Bessier. The interviewers then ask about drummer Mike Murray, whom Vincent can barely recall.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
